note: Registered templates for the GLM-5 PoC. sha256 pins the template file bytes under digest_rule 'sha256-lf' (SHA-256 over CRLF->LF normalized bytes), so the pin equals the git blob of the text file and survives CRLF/LF checkouts; the executor refuses a template whose bytes do not match (TEMPLATE_HASH_MISMATCH). Binary fixtures are pinned by raw bytes. Data-only manifests: the registry loader rejects code vectors (F10).
